driver_archetypes.rationale: Standard compliant car behavior to match M1/car discharge headway (0.335s) and ensure correct lane positioning.
Higher impatience and slightly larger gaps allow occasional early starts (M2/early/car) without excessive red-running.
Slightly higher tau mimics the observed discharge headway (M1/moto ~0.25s) which is slower than cars, while tight lateral gaps prevent overshoot.
Higher tau and center alignment mimic slow riders who overshoot the stop line (M4/overshoot_share) and maintain lateral position near 7m.
Custom1 base class enables queue_space_seeking to ride in lane 0 (wrong lane) to bypass queues (M8/moto wrong-lane share).
High tau/minGap ensures illegal left-turners wait in the box until opposing green ends (M6/approach/l/moto, M7a/n_waiting).

traci_rules.rationale: Target M2/early/car (0.0074); moderate probability prevents overshooting observed share while allowing some creep.
Target M2/early/moto (0.1303); higher probability for standard motorcycles to creep in the last seconds of red.
Target M3/share/moto (0.09048) and M3/var_to_mean; moderate base probability and swarm effect simulate group red-running without excessive collisions.
Target M8/moto wrong-lane share (0.2131); force usage of adjacent lane (lane 0) to bypass queues when queue length > 50m.
Target M7a/release_time (0.28s) and M6/junction/illegal_l/moto; small release lag ensures exit shortly after opposing green ends.
Target M4/lat_moto (7.1m); lat_offset 0 keeps the slow motorcycle in the lane center to minimize overshoot.
Target M9b/delay_blocked; high probability reflects that motorcycles frequently squeeze past standing U-turners.
